shots.name: SR-place-Alftand
shots.note: Tamriel, Alftand exterior (cells AlftandExterior01-03 around 78000,78000,-5000). Placed by eye from the aerial reference: the two ShackKit shacks (79460,78620,-4650 and 80620,77450,-4530), the tower with the DweFacadeTowerArch1x4 (80001,75827, arch at -4169) and the tower at (73422,78436,-5641). Confidence: low - the towers in this shot cannot be told apart with certainty, so this pose is a plausible north-west high view, not a fit. The reference is 1440x1080; this file's 1400x1050 window keeps the same aspect.

shots.name: SR-place-Alftand_02
shots.note: Tamriel, Alftand exterior. Landmarks used: the big arch tower on the right = DweFacadeTower1x3Snow + Arch01Snow + Roof01SnowHeavy at (73422,78436,-5641); the small pointed-roof tower centre-left = DweFacadeTower1x4Snow + Roof02Snow at (77992,78336,-6202), scale 1.25; the round tower with the conical roof at bottom centre = DweFacadeTower02Snow + Roof02Snow at (75982,78972,-8106) (the tower whose door leads to AlftandZCell). Four-landmark least-squares fit, rms 95 px; three of the four projections were checked against the picture by eye. Confidence: medium - the tower identities are the best of the assignments tried (see docs/research/reference-shot-poses.md).

shots.name: SR-place-Alftand_03
shots.note: Tamriel, Alftand exterior, the same ravine as _02 seen a little closer and from slightly higher. Landmarks: the same arch tower (73422,78436,-5641) right of centre and the two ShackKit shacks on the snow shelf (79460,78620,-4650 and 80620,77450,-4530). Confidence: low - the fit for this frame did not converge below 100 px for any tower assignment, so the pose is the _02 camera moved to match the wider framing by eye.

shots.name: SR-place-Alftand_04
shots.note: Tamriel, Alftand exterior. The frame is dominated by wooden footbridges seen from below; the Alftand entrance door (0x15D48) sits on the bridge platform at (78049,76985,-5859) with StockadeScaffoldBridge04 at (77969,77096,-5822) and the rope runs MineScaffoldRopeLong03 at (77568..77697,77318..77452,-5793). Camera is under that platform looking up at it. Confidence: medium - the platform, the entrance marker and the ropes are unambiguous; only the exact look-up angle is guesswork.

shots.name: SR-place-Alftand_05
shots.note: Tamriel, Alftand exterior, from the bottom of the ravine looking up at a tower with a snow-covered roof, a rope bridge crossing above and a wooden scaffold on the right. Best guess: the tower is A (77992,78336,-6202, scale 1.25), the bridge above is the entrance chain (77969,77096,-5822) and the scaffold is the entrance platform. Confidence: low - the tower could equally be C (80001,75827) seen from the west; check the render for which tower sits behind the frame's left edge.

shots.name: SR-place-Alftand_06
shots.note: Tamriel, Alftand exterior, straight-down free-camera view of the whole site. Landmarks: the two ribbed round roofs = the two scale-1.25 towers, A (77992,78336,-6202) top-left and C (80001,75827) top-right; the two Shacks (79460,78620 and 80620,77450) below them. Fitted at rms 190 px for A+C; the A/B alternative fitted worse. Confidence: medium - the pose is right to a few hundred units and a few degrees, but one of the four round structures in the frame is not explained by the database objects I matched.

shots.name: SR-place-Alftand_07
shots.note: Tamriel, inside a wooden ShackKit shack, looking down at the snow-covered floor (bedroll, shovel, barrel, hide). Placed in the larger shack at (79460,78620,-4650), floor at z=-4650, eye 500 above it. Confidence: low - the two shacks cannot be told apart from the frame, and the camera height is a guess.

shots.name: SR-place-Alftand_08
shots.note: Tamriel, inside a wooden ShackKit shack, seen from the doorway looking out through the open frame. Same shack as _07 (79460,78620,-4650). Confidence: low - the shack and the direction are guesses; the render only has to show the inside of a shack frame with snow outside.

shots.name: SR-place-Alftand_Ruined_Tower
shots.note: Tamriel, the small Dwemer tower whose door leads into AlftandZCell: DweFacadeTower1x3Snow + DweFacadeTowerArch01Snow + DweFacadeTowerRoof01SnowHeavy at (73422,78436,-5641) with DweDoorFrameExBgtoExSm01 + DweDoorSmall01Load at (73550,78431,-5609). Camera on the snow ~1900 units south of it, eye ~550 above the ground. Confidence: medium - the door frame style (big arch, small door) matches this tower and the other tower with a DweDoorFrameExBgtoExSm01 (75982,78972,-8106) sits deep in the ravine, which the picture's open snow and sky do not look like. The reference is 2880x2160; this file's window keeps the same 4:3 aspect.

shots.name: SR-interior-Alftand_02
shots.note: AlftandZCell (0x69858, 432216) - the small Dwemer room reached from the two ruined-tower doors: the room pieces DweFacadeHallSm1wayRamp01/Alcove01 sit at (512..1280, 8500..8920, -5997..-6448) with two DweDresser01, a DweRunner and banners. Camera inside that room at eye height looking across it. Confidence: low - the room could equally be one of the Alftand02 crew rooms; what the frame does show is a small Dwemer room with two tables and a bench.

shots.name: SR-interior-Alftand_03
shots.note: Alftand01, Alftand Glacial Ruins (86723), on the stair corridor that runs up to the Dwemer large door 0x92809 into Alftand02 at (4057,8792,-516). The overhead brass pipes are the DwePipe1way01 cluster at (3081..3881, 8648..8952, -772/-836), and DwePipeGearAssemblyCCW01 sits at (3272,8775,-76). Camera on the corridor floor looking up at the door. Confidence: medium - the door, its pipes and the stair are all at this one place in Alftand01; the exact stand-off is a guess.

shots.name: SR-interior-Alftand_04
shots.note: Alftand02, the Animonculory. The vertical cavern is built around the ice shaft (CaveIShaftRWall/Door pieces) at (6351,-4729) stacked from z -1000 to -9400, with DwePipeCap01 at (6605,-4070) and DwePipeCap02 at (7678,-2637) running from -7000 up to the ceiling, and DweFacadeLiftUp01 at (6479,-185,-7176). This shot looks steeply up the middle of that shaft at the pipe work. Confidence: low - the space is certain (only Alftand02 has this machinery), the camera and the up-angle are not.

shots.name: SR-interior-Alftand_05
shots.note: Alftand02, Animonculory. The frame is the ribbed underside of the round platform above, which is the same machinery layout as _04 (ice shaft at 6351,-4729; pipe caps at 6605,-4070 and 7678,-2637). Camera below the platform looking up. Confidence: low - see _04.

shots.name: SR-interior-Alftand_06
shots.note: Alftand02, Animonculory, looking up at the pipe column at (6605,-4070) (DwePipeCap01 x33, spanning z -6824..-512) with its two bell caps. Confidence: low - the pipe column is a good landmark but the camera could be on either side of it.

shots.name: SR-interior-Alftand_07
shots.note: Alftand02, Animonculory, beside the same pipe column (6605,-4070) as _06, looking up past it at the ice wall of the shaft. Confidence: low.

shots.name: SR-interior-Alftand_08
shots.note: Alftand02, Animonculory, between the two pipe columns (6605,-4070 and 7678,-2637) looking up at the crossing pipes (DwePipe1wayX2way x38 at 6978,-4304,-5003). Confidence: low.

shots.name: SR-interior-Alftand_09
shots.note: Alftand02, Animonculory, under the second pipe column (DwePipeCap02 x30 at 7678,-2637, z -7304..-64) looking up at the caps and the fan (DwePipe1wayFan01). Confidence: low.

shots.name: SR-interior-Alftand_10
shots.note: Alftand02, Animonculory, looking down at the round lift platform: DweFacadeLiftUp01 (6479,-185,-7176), the cellar the player enters the Animonculory by. Confidence: low - the round rimmed platform is the lift by its shape, but the camera height above it is a guess.

shots.name: SR-interior-Alftand_11
shots.note: Alftand01, on the approach stair to the Dwemer large door 0x92809 (4057,8792,-516) into Alftand02: the door is a golden Dwemer load door, and the frame's frost patch and cobwebs match FXSteamCrack and FXcobwebWall01 placed at (3613..3909, 8574..8952). Confidence: low-medium - the corridor and door are right; which of Alftand01's three stairs this is, is a guess.

shots.name: SR-interior-Alftand_12
shots.note: Blackreach, the Alftand exit structure (cell AlftandBlackreach01 0x237BD): DweFacadeTowerArch01 + DweFacadeHallSmExBg01 + the large door 0x4E504 all at (21150,18531,2432), with DweFacadePartition01 at (21301,18042) and (20998,19020) and the platform DwePlatBgMid01 at (20981,18714,2431). Camera at the top of the stair looking out through the arch into the Blackreach cavern. Confidence: medium - the structure is the only place in Blackreach with this door and arch; the camera stand-off is a guess.

shots.name: SR-interior-Alftand_13
shots.note: AlftandWorld (432215), the cathedral area. The domed towers (DweFacadeTower02 x14, DweFacadeTowerArch01 x13, DweFacadeTowerRoof01/02) stand at -3864,1543 / -3658,1161 / -4132,842 and the round plaza under the camera in the frame is the DwePlatBg*/DwePlatCorOut platform cluster at (-2397..-3045, 1713..2534, 1255). Checked by projection: with this pose DweFacadeTower02 lands on the big dome at the lower left of the frame and the DwePlatBgWall/CorOut pieces on the plaza rim (local/reference/fits/check_i13b.jpg). Confidence: medium - the domed towers and the circular plaza only exist in AlftandWorld; the height above the plaza is a guess.

shots.name: SR-interior-Alftand_14
shots.note: AlftandWorld (432215), looking up a stair at the glowing orb on its stand (FXGlowFillRoundMid FXGlowFillRndLitMid at -1091,2681,2167 with DweFloorLantern at -1561,2550) between two domed towers. Confidence: low-medium - the orb and the stair exist at this spot, but the frame could also be the top of the cathedral stair.

shots.name: SR-place-Blackreach
shots.note: Blackreach, looking over the giant mushrooms at a tower with a lit doorway. The one giant mushroom is BlackreachEpicMushroom01 at (10929,8943,1533) (scale 2.37, 5446 units tall); the rest of the frame is the BlackreachGiantMushAnim/Horiz clusters and the BlackreachLargeDrip columns. Camera ~2500 south-west of the epic mushroom. Confidence: low - the mushroom is certain, the direction and the tower in the frame are not. The reference is 1440x1080 (same 4:3 aspect).

shots.name: SR-place-Blackreach_02
shots.note: Blackreach. Landmarks: the glowing lattice orb on the left of the frame is BlackreachSun01 at (2112,9088,6336) (the only one in the world, bbox x +-777, y -2205..8469) and the huge mushroom filling the right of the frame is one of the BlackreachGiantMushAnim05 cluster at (1462,10885,1179) / Anim01 at (1880,11910,970). Camera ~2200 units south-east of the sun with the mushroom to its right, so the two are ~50 degrees apart as in the frame. Confidence: medium - the sun is unique and the frame's two landmarks are the two nearest giant objects to it.

shots.name: SR-place-Blackreach_03
shots.note: Blackreach: a domed Dwemer tower with a lit doorway in the left foreground, a walkway, and the cavern with the water columns (BlackreachLargeDripAnim01-03) behind. Placed on the BlackreachTowers / BlackreachCity side of the cavern (towers at 8000..9000, 6000..7000) looking north-west at the drips. Confidence: low - no single landmark in the frame could be matched to the database with certainty.
